crossRefs.note: “Hear, our God; for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land…
Don’t cover their iniquity. Don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”
Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its…
Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have…
Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin…
May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on…
For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…
“From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has…
For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim.
Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.
Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

translations.web: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
translations.bsb: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
translations.kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
translations.asv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; And do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
